The fairest of them all...the funniest of them all!

How do you wake up from a nightmare if you’re not asleep?

Where monsters go to get away from it all.

New places. New faces. Next level.

With neighbors like these, who needs family?

He's an orphan... at the start of a journey. A journey to survive.

Prof. Jordan / Peter Cornelius / Dr. Mabuse

The Manhunt They Had to Put On the Giant-Sized Movie Theater Screen!

They're not looking for love, they're looking for a wife!

Ram Prasad Dasharath Prasad Sharma / Laxman Prasad Dasharath Prasad Sharma

Son Goku / Son Gohan / Son Goten / Gotenks (voice)

Princess Rudrama Devi / Prince Rudradeva Maharaja

She turned down Hollywood to become Goebbels' lover: Lída Baarová

Businessman (segment "Right Brain / Martyrdom") / Doppelganger (segment "Right Brain / Martyrdom")

Trapped On A Lost World of Prehistoric Monsters

She's wild. She's wicked. And she really knows how to whip up a good time!

On the football field, he was a whirlwind- but when Ol' Dan Cupid tackled him, he went down without a struggle!

Mile-High Suspense In The Grand Canyon!

The best partners in the police station.

Edited from TV series, The Travels of Jaimie McPheeters

Chuck Norris Explodes Across the Screen!
